description: Demo presets recreating media.html — every distinct attribute combination on the page, keyed media-*. Furniture tokens (chip/sticker/save/play positions + hues) are appended by the renderer from card content and never appear here. The overlays section reuses the base 'showcase' preset from card.presets.json.
